f0.why: Sentence 8 names exactly these two things: compaction under successive layers and cementation by precipitated minerals.

f1.why: Sentence 3 gives reduction in porosity and water expulsion in the early stages.

f2.why: Sentence 10 says porosity usually decreases except in rare cases.
